estimatedSavingsNotes: DeepTracker non-priority interval changed from 2.5 seconds to 15 seconds.
Pagehide, visibility hidden, cleanup, and priority flush paths use one closeout key per route session.
Hover and visibility events now emit summaries instead of per-transition streams.
Scroll uses requestAnimationFrame and 25/50/75/100 milestones instead of 500ms polling.
Identity link writes pending state before send, then stores success or retry-after state to prevent duplicate bursts.

fixesApplied.detail: Added client telemetry priority classification, moved non-priority flushes to 15 seconds, and lowered the non-priority queue cap to 200 while preserving immediate/next-turn priority flushes.
Visibility hidden, pagehide, cleanup, and priority closeouts share a route-session closeout key and prefer beacon/keepalive for final sends.
Hover, visibility, and scroll now summarize state; scroll emits only max depth and 25/50/75/100 milestones via requestAnimationFrame.
Identity link submission marks a pending state before fetch, writes a sent state on success, and writes a retry-after window on failure without blocking auth.

deferredFindings.reason: This phase scoped DeepTracker and identity link volume. The separate src/lib/telemetry.ts queue still has its own scheduled/pagehide/visibility behavior and should be reviewed without mixing contracts.
deferredFindings.nextStep: Run a focused pass on global trackEvent batching, preserving purchase/auth/conversion immediacy.

deferredFindings.reason: Summaries reuse existing ingest-safe fields instead of adding new payload keys to the anonymous ingest schema in this client-only pass.
deferredFindings.nextStep: If richer summary dimensions are needed, update the anonymous ingest schema and analytics contract in a dedicated server/client contract pass.
